videos.title: The Hacker Who Hunts Predators: Do These 3 Things Before You Get Hacked! | Ryan "0day" Montgomery
videos.description:
What could a hacker find about you in just 20 minutes? Old passwords? Phone number? Childhood home? Ethical hacker Ryan Montgomery aka 0day reveals how exposed your personal data already is, and the simple moves that protect your online privacy.

Ryan Montgomery is an ethical hacker and cybersecurity expert who overcame addiction and jail as a teenager to become a go-to expert helping law enforcement unmask online predators. He is the founder of the cybersecurity company Pentester and works with the Sentinel Foundation on child-crime and counter-trafficking investigations. His tools are built on the same technology he uses to track predators, and they show ordinary people exactly what’s exposed about them online and then remove it.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Reverse Password Trap:* One unique old password leaked in a data breach lets hackers trace every other email account you’ve ever tied to it.
■ *The Invisible Footprint:* Even people who have never used a computer are exposed, because pharmacy sign-ups and hacked company databases feed data brokers who sell your address to anyone.
■ *The Fake Free Wi-Fi:* Hackers can create a fake public Wi-Fi network with a fake login page in seconds and capture your email and password the moment you sign in.
■ *The Airplane Mode Myth:* Airplane mode leaves Bluetooth switched on, so nearby attackers can still reach your phone unless you turn Bluetooth off in Settings.
■ *The Smart Home Backdoor:* Many cheap smart bulbs and plugs send your commands through overseas servers, so keep them on a separate network from your phone and laptop.

If you or someone you know has been affected by the issues in this episode, help is available. In the UK, contact the Samaritans on 116 123 or the NSPCC on 0808 800 5000 (tel:08088005000). In the US, call or text 988, or report child exploitation to the NCMEC CyberTipline at report.cybertip.org. If a child is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
